verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents a Files API for creating, reading, editing, moving, and deleting files and folders (dropbox-docs-3). The official JS SDK shows folder listing via filesListFolder (dropbox-gh-1), and there is first-party guidance on performant uploads (dropbox-docs-21), backed by official API v2 SDKs and API documentation pages. The probes found no OpenAPI spec and no markdown docs, but that does not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the raw REST/HTTP endpoints (e.g., the upload and download endpoint reference), explicit download evidence beyond "reading", and independent hands-on corroboration.
